say:1:1623333001:1.text: On behalf of my little lamb, thank you!

say:3:1623333002:1.text: We did! We came up with thirty names, then picked the one that rolls off the tongue best.

say:4:1623333003:1.text: We're calling it "Lamb". What do you think?

say:7:1623333007:1.text: Well, name or no name, you brought it so much food. It's going to be thrilled!

say:9:1623333005:1.source_cn: 正是，我就觉得这个名字最适合它！
